local function MakeDraggable(topbarobject, object)
	local Dragging = nil
	local DragInput = nil
	local DragStart = nil
	local StartPosition = nil

	local function Update(input)
		local Delta = input.Position - DragStart
		local pos =
			UDim2.new(
				StartPosition.X.Scale,
				StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
				StartPosition.Y.Scale,
				StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
			)
		object.Position = pos
	end

	topbarobject.InputBegan:Connect(
		function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				Dragging = true
				DragStart = input.Position
				StartPosition = object.Position

				input.Changed:Connect(
					function()
						if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
							Dragging = false
						end
					end
				)
			end
		end
	)

	topbarobject.InputChanged:Connect(
		function(input)
			if
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				DragInput = input
			end
		end
	)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(
		function(input)
			if input == DragInput and Dragging then
				Update(input)
			end
		end
	)
end

local function isLegacyChatRemote(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance"
        and inst.ClassName == "RemoteEvent"
        and inst.Name == "SayMessageRequest"
end

local function isTextChannel(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst.ClassName == "TextChannel"
end

if not State.hooked then
    State.hooked = true

    if hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod then
        local oldNamecall
        oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
            if State.enabled then
                local method = getnamecallmethod()
                if method == "FireServer" and isLegacyChatRemote(self) then
                    return
                end
                if method == "SendAsync" and isTextChannel(self) then
                    return
                end
            end
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)

    else
        warn("[ChatBlocker] executor has no hookmetamethod, namecall hook will not be installed")

                    if State.enabled and check(self) then

local function translateText(text, targetLang)

    local url =
        "https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single" ..
        "?client=gtx" ..
        "&sl=en" ..
        "&tl=" .. targetLang ..
        "&dt=t&q=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(text)

    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)

    if not success then
        return "HTTP Failed"
    end

    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(result)
    end)

    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Decode Failed"
    end

    if data and data[1] and data[1][1] and data[1][1][1] then
        return data[1][1][1]
    end

    return "Translation Error"
end

        if setclipboard then
            setclipboard(translated)
            outputLabel.Text = translated .. " (Copied)"

        elseif toclipboard then
            toclipboard(translated)
            outputLabel.Text = translated .. " (Copied)"
        end
    end)
end
